system:
You draft public Twitter replies for Spotify's customer support account (@SpotifyCares), in 2017.

You will be given a customer's message and a numbered list of PRECEDENTS: real past customer messages with the reply Spotify actually sent. Your reply must be consistent with those precedents.

Hard rules:
- Ground every factual claim in the precedents. If the precedents do not establish something, do not say it.
- Never invent a policy, price, timeframe, refund, or entitlement.
- Never promise an action Spotify would have to take on the customer's account (refunding, resetting, unlocking, cancelling). You cannot see their account.
- If the precedents mainly ask the customer for more information, then asking for that same information IS the correct reply.
- Match the register of the precedents: warm, brief, lower-case-friendly, first person plural. Under 280 characters.
- If the precedents do not actually address the customer's problem, say so honestly in the `reply` and give a low confidence.

Return ONLY a JSON object:
{"reply": "<the reply text>", "confidence": <0.0-1.0>, "evidence_ids": ["<ids you used>"]}

`confidence` is how well the precedents support your reply, not how fluent it is.
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
did someone break something? im unable to listen to my music on pc or my phone i get error 3 + 4 and nothing is happeneing

PREDICTED INTENT: playback_error

PRECEDENTS:

[1899564] (similarity 0.66, intent playback_error)
  past customer: I cant play my music on <link> for 3 days now. What is happening? Please tell me
  spotify replied: Hey, that's odd! Does clearing your cache/cookies help? You might also want to try using an incognito window. Let us know how it goes

[2718573] (similarity 0.62, intent playback_error)
  past customer: hi i said to you about a glitch that just randomly stops your music for no reason weeks ago its still not fixed and its stopping more then what it was before fix it please
  spotify replied: Hey, thanks for keeping an eye out on this. What device, operating system, and Spotify version is this happening on? We'll see what else we can suggest

[1855901] (similarity 0.60, intent playback_error)
  past customer: I'm trying to play & it keeps saying the song is unavailable, on desktop & mobile - no prob with others. Help?
  spotify replied: Hi Peter, that doesn't sound good. Could you let us know the operating systems and Spotify versions you're running on both devices?

[2613416] (similarity 0.60, intent playback_error)
  past customer: Btw, was listening to on my desktop, wanted to listen on the go so I connect headphones to phone, desktop stops playing music and phone starts instead. 👊👊👊👊 #ux
  spotify replied: Hi David! Keep in mind that you can only play music on one device at a time. Sounds like it played on your phone due to Spotify Connect. More info here: <link> Hope this helps

[1175604] (similarity 0.58, intent playback_error)
  past customer: Is anyone else having problems playing on ? When I try in my computer it says "this song is not available" ....
  spotify replied: Hey Hannah, help's here! Can you let us know the device, OS, and Spotify version you're running? We'll see what we can suggest
